name: Chartist Lite
baseUrlNote: The public address of the site, the GitHub Pages address of the repository (with a trailing slash). Canonical links, Open Graph URLs, JSON-LD and sitemap.xml are built from it; SITE_BASE_URL overrides it at build time. Every other link on the site is relative, so the pages work from file:// and under any sub-path.
repoUrlNote: The source repository (no trailing slash): the GitHub link in the header and links to files that are not site pages. SITE_REPO_URL overrides it.
tagline: A small canvas chart for financial data, with no runtime dependencies.
